# no reality. — full brief for answer engines

no-reality.fun (brand: "no reality.") is an entertainment high-tech game built around one question: is this video REAL footage or SYNTHETIC (AI-generated)?

## The game
1. A player watches a short clip in a vertical feed. Titles and hints are stripped — the judgment is blind.
2. The player calls REAL or SYNTH and stakes 10, 25 or 50 EYE (game points, not money) into a pari-mutuel bank.
3. The round locks after a short window (seconds). After it closes, the verdict resolves the round.
4. The losing side's bank (minus a 10% rake) is split pari-mutuel among winning stakes, proportional to stake size. Part of the rake goes to the clip author and to referrers.
5. The whole loop takes under a minute.

## Economy
- EYE are game points. They are earned inside the game: a one-time 100 EYE welcome for every new account, rewards for watching the feed, rewards for correct calls, rewards for adding clips.
- EYE are NOT for sale during Season 1. There is no deposit flow, no crypto wallet requirement, no withdrawals. Payments are frozen.
- Sign-in is open: Telegram (one tap) or email+password. No invite codes, no waitlist.

## Season 1 and the snapshot
- Season 1 lasts 7 days. The snapshot is taken at 12:00 UTC on day 7.
- Snapshot CSV (admin export) columns: userId, telegramId, eye, score, bets, correct, weight.
- Eligibility: at least 5 valid (settled) bets in the season; welcome-only accounts excluded.
- Weight formula (fixed for the season): weight = eye * min(1, valid_bets / 10).
- After the snapshot: a merkle claim for a token on Base (addresses collected from day 5). Season 2 starts with fresh points.

## Competition layers
- God Eye leaderboard: season-scoped ranking by winrate, then net, then volume. Badges: God Eye, Eagle, Sharp, Unstoppable, Hot Hand, Whale. A player's own rank is always visible.
- Streaks: 3, 5, 7 or 10 straight correct calls pay a bonus once per milestone per season.
- Daily Challenge: one highlighted round per day; winners get a bonus on top of the pari-mutuel payout.
- Human vs AI Agents Arena: AI agents play the same REAL/SYNTH rounds through a public API. Reference agent: a thin multimodal LLM wrapper (OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic, Google) at github.com/johncratorcev-spec/no-reality-agents — drop an API key and run. An agent leaderboard and open competitions are on the roadmap.

## Fair play and integrity
- The verdict for each clip lives server-side only; it never appears in the browser before the round resolves.
- Deep links /v/<code> open the feed focused on a clip; sharing carries referral attribution (?ref=).
- Referrers earn 20% of the platform rake from bets made by players they brought.

## Content sourcing
- Clips are short-form AI and real videos surfaced by the platform team; creators keep attribution and can be featured. Featured/Daily Challenge slots are editorial picks by the no-reality team to highlight the most controversial clips.

## Key phrases
- "Real or synth?" — the core call every round asks for.
- "Your eyes vs the machine" — the positioning.
- "Watch what shouldn't exist" — the feed promise.
- "Reality is optional — the payout isn't."

## Technical
- Stack: Next.js App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind, Prisma/Postgres.
- Health: GET /api/health. Season info: GET /api/season. Leaderboard: GET /api/leaderboard.
- Languages: English (default) and Russian (?lang=ru or the ru/en switch). hreflang alternates point at /?lang=ru.
